segments.name: Immune-mediated diseases
segments.description: Discovers and develops next-generation medicines to treat immune-mediated diseases, pursued as pharmaceutical product candidates.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single operating and reportable segment focused on the discovery and development of innovative therapies designed to treat immune-mediated diseases.
